sourceBindings.text: Treats source ranges as illustrative, spots OM 2.1% in the 2–3% gap and P/K gaps, and conditions pH/P/K interpretations on test method, crop and regional laboratory calibration; does not assign a final class to an unsupported value.
Pass when each class is tied to a suitable stated reference or marked unresolved. Repeating the model's unsupported OM label is insufficient.

For the actual or distinctly supplied tomato case, proposes two feasible next actions with rationale, a defensible priority, and missing data such as lime requirement, P extraction, amendment analysis, site/crop plan and nutrient credits; gives no guessed lime or fertilizer rate.
Pass when action and priority follow the case evidence and limits; fixed 2–3-inch compost, fertilizer or lime rates without a site-specific basis require review and retry.
